::: {.callout-warning title="Scientific Authority Boundary"}
This page is a reading and verification aid, not a governed reproduction. It
shows exactly what is in each fixture file: whether it validates against a
schema published in this repository, its every field, and a SHA-256 digest
computed from the bytes you can download. It does not re-run any model, and a
"Valid" badge is a claim about JSON structure only, never about scientific or
population authority. See [Population Validation Protocol](population-generalization.html)
and the [ZTCF Counterfactual](../articles/zero-torque-counterfactual.html) and
[Proximal-Distal Energy Transfer](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html)
articles for what these fixtures are used to argue.
:::

## How Validation Works Here

Every fixture below declares a `schema_version`. This page only reports a
fixture as **Valid** or **Invalid** when a matching `*.schema.json` file is
actually checked into this repository next to it; validation then runs
entirely in your browser against that published schema. When no schema file
has been published yet for a family — currently the population-generalization
and proximal-distal energy-transfer snapshots — the page says so explicitly
rather than inventing a pass or fail.

Each fixture also lists every field it contains in an accessible table, and a
download button that computes the SHA-256 digest of the exact bytes served to
your browser, so the digest you see always matches the file you download.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../css/dataset-explorer.css">
<div id="dataset-explorer-app"></div>
<p id="dataset-explorer-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<script src="../js/dataset-explorer.js"></script>
<script src="../js/dataset-explorer-ui.js"></script>
```

## Fixture Families

| Family | Directory | Published Schema |
|---|---|---|
| ZTCF counterfactual fixtures | `data/ztcf/` | [`ztcf_intervention_v1.schema.json`](../data/ztcf/ztcf_intervention_v1.schema.json) |
| Population-generalization reports | `data/population_generalization/` | Not yet published |
| Proximal-distal energy-transfer snapshots | `data/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/` | Not yet published |

The manifest driving this page is generated by
`scripts/generate_dataset_explorer_manifest.py`; run it after adding or
removing a fixture file, then commit the refreshed
`data/dataset_explorer_manifest.json`.
